_comment: Queries phrased the way a student types them -- not as keyword strings.
Three kinds, tagged so a regression can be traced to a category:
paraphrase  -- asks for a concept without using its name
ambiguous   -- a term that means different things in two subjects; the
correct passage is only recoverable from context
multi       -- more than one passage genuinely answers it
'relevant' lists every passage a tutor could legitimately cite. Being
strict here would punish correct behaviour, and being loose would make
